title: Equations and inequalities
summary: Solving equations with fractions, brackets and pronumerals on both sides, simple quadratic equations, formulas, word problems and inequalities.

cards.title: Reviewing equations
cards.rule: An equation has an equals sign. The solution is the value that makes it true.

cards.title: Equivalent equations
cards.rule: Do the same to both sides. Undo in reverse order.

cards.title: Equations with fractions
cards.rule: Clear the fraction by multiplying both sides.

cards.title: Pronumeral on both sides
cards.rule: Subtract the smaller term so the pronumeral is on one side.

cards.title: Simple quadratic equations
cards.rule: Get \(x^2\) by itself, then take the square root. Remember both answers.
cards.note: \(x^2 = -4\) has no solution: a square can't be negative.

cards.title: Formulas and relationships
cards.rule: Substitute what you know, then solve for what's left.

cards.title: Applications of equations
cards.rule: Let a letter be the unknown, write an equation, solve it, answer in words.
lines: Double a number and add 5 to get 17: \(2x + 5 = 17\), so the number is 6
Rectangle, width \(w\), length \(2w\), perimeter 30: \(6w = 30\), so 5 by 10

cards.title: Inequalities
cards.rule: \(<\) less than, \(\le\) less than or equal, \(>\) greater than, \(\ge\) greater than or equal.

cards.title: Solving inequalities
cards.rule: Solve like an equation, but flip the sign when you multiply or divide by a negative.
cards.tip: flip the sign when dividing by a negative.
